html:
Thule Air Base, now Pituffik Space Base, was built by the United States in north western Greenland in 1951 to 1953, under a defence agreement with Denmark. It is the northernmost US military base.

During the Cold War it housed bombers and later radar to warn of Soviet missiles. In 1953 the Inughuit of the nearby village of Uummannaq were moved, at a few days' notice, to Qaanaaq 100 kilometres north. In 1968 a B-52 bomber carrying four hydrogen bombs crashed on the sea ice nearby, spreading radioactive material.

Danish courts and a public apology in 1999 recognised the wrong done in the relocation. The base keeps Greenland central to the strategy of NATO and the United States.
sum: Thule Air Base, now Pituffik Space Base, was built by the United States in north western Greenland in 1951 to 1953, under a defence agreement with Denmark. It is the northernmost US military base.
